subject: CardioWave: tenant provisioning & API key seeding
messages:
From: Anna Liu <anna@cardiowave.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cardiowave.com
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New tenant & API onboarding - CardioWave

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. CardioWave is ready to start the technical onboarding. High-level asks from our side:

- New tenant/workspace in us-west for production traffic (we expect ~10RPS steady, spikes to 50RPS).
- One admin API key for our platform team, plus two SEAT invites for product/ops admins.
- SSO support (we use Okta) — we can provide metadata later if you support SAML.
- Any required procurement info or PO you need to proceed (cc'd procurement).
We'd like to aim for a soft go-live the week of Mar 25. Can you confirm timeline and what you need from us to seed the admin key and invite the first users?

Thanks,
Anna Liu
Director of Platform
CardioWave

--
Attachment: none (PO expected separately)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Liu <anna@cardiowave.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New tenant & API onboarding - CardioWave

Hi Anna — great to connect earlier. Welcome aboard.

Plan proposal and immediate asks:

1) We'll provision a dedicated workspace named "cardiowave-prod" in us-west and create a project "cw-integrations".
2) We will seed a workspace_admin API key (we will not send secrets over email; we'll provide a short-lived token via the console or secure link).
3) Please send the list of admin invite emails (two for now) and confirm whether you want SSO enabled at go-live or staged after initial testing.
4) I'll loop in our CS engineer (Monica) and Solutions (Dev) to handle seeding and invites.
Attached is a short onboarding checklist to align timelines. Can we schedule a 30-min tech kickoff on Tue Mar 19 at 10:00 PT?

I'll follow up with internal steps once Monica confirms.
Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
--
Attachment: CardioWave-onboarding-checklist.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2029 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: New tenant & API onboarding - CardioWave — please seed admin + invites
Monica/Dev,

Forwarding Anna's request. Quick action items I need from you both:

- Monica: please provision a workspace named "cardiowave-prod" in us-west and create project "cw-integrations". Set the default token expiration to 30 days for seeded keys (we'll provide rotation guidance later).
- Dev: coordinate quota/rate-limit settings (10RPS steady, 50RPS burst) and create a sandbox project if Anna wants immediate testing before production.
- Both: invite anna@cardiowave.com and procurement@cardiowave.com as workspace members with role "workspace_admin" for Anna and "billing_contact" for procurement.
Please confirm done and paste the console links (or the place-holder key) — do not paste actual secrets in this thread; use the secure token delivery in the console. I'm attaching a small seed script you can run in the console (internal) to create the project and apply RBAC.
Thanks — going to set the kickoff for Mar 19.
Marcus
-- Forwarded message follows --
Attachment: seed-script.sh

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

- Admin invites: anna@cardiowave.com (workspace_admin) and procurement@cardiowave.com (billing_contact) — invite emails sent.

I'll join the Mar 19 tech kickoff to walk through the console.
Cheers,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
